narrative_synthesis: Saturday's watchlist was carried by builders and savers: levelsio's charger swap topped the day, gregisenberg's vertical-agent and 'AI pilled company' lists drew the most bookmarks, and SahilBloom's short-horizon advice did steady numbers. The Nvidia leadership story is still everywhere and stays off limits for replies and drafts. In Indochina, Thailand had a busy AI day (free OpenThai real-time speech-to-text, Meta's Dream Renderer video tool) and Vietnam showed government AI cutting report time from days to an hour.

indochina_ai.title: OpenThai 2.0 ASR Streaming released (13 Nov): free real-time Thai speech-to-text, text appears 0.08 to 1.12 seconds after speech, can run on an organisation's own servers, free for commercial use; aimed at live captions for classes, meetings, news and deaf viewers

Meta launches Dream Renderer (brief, product photo or script into a video in minutes) and Omnichannel Collaboration Ads in Thailand, one of the first markets; a Meta-commissioned YouGov survey says 85% of Thai small business owners use AI

Ministry of Finance AI assistant built with FPT Smart Cloud: after about 6 months of trial, monthly socio-economic report drafting fell from 1-2 days to about one hour; 479 staff used it, 4,650 sessions, 3,609 standard reports
Science and Technology Minister Vu Hai Quan tells the National Assembly that officials must not enter classified data into AI tools; ministry has issued an AI ethics framework under the 2025 AI Law
